rule.CONFIRMED: every held-out item rebuilt and identity-checked; independent HiGHS optimum equals the recorded truth on every item; every arm's recorded outcome and throughput reproduce under the independent max-flow rescoring
rule.INCOMPLETE: any item that cannot be rebuilt or identity-checked, or any MILP that does not reach proven optimality with an integral value
rule.REFUTED: any item whose recorded truth differs from the independent optimum, or any arm whose recorded outcome or throughput does not reproduce
